def rgb_to_hsv(r, g, b):
    r, g, b = r / 255.0, g / 255.0, b / 255.0
    maximum = max(r, g, b)
    minimum = min(r, g, b)
    delta = maximum - minimum

    if delta == 0:
        hue = 0
    elif maximum == r:
        hue = (60 * ((g - b) / delta)) % 360
    elif maximum == g:
        hue = 60 * ((b - r) / delta + 2)
    else:
        hue = 60 * ((r - g) / delta + 4)

    saturation = 0.0 if maximum == 0 else (delta / maximum) * 100
    value = maximum * 100

    return hue, saturation, value
